newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BAKERO TO JOIN MEXICAN CLUB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAKERO TO JOIN MEXICAN CLUB.

text.p: Former international midfielder Jose Maria Bakero will leave Barcelona and join Mexican club Veracruz in the next few weeks, sources at the Spanish club said on Tuesday.
Bakero, 33, won 30 caps and has scored 136 goals in 479 first division games but has disappeared from the Barcelona line-up since the arrival of new coach Bobby Robson.
Two other former Spanish internationals -- ex-Real Madrid players Emilio Butragueno and Michel Gonzalez -- play for another Mexican club, Atletico Celaya.
